label: Ex4 – Batch reactor (DT form)
inp:
[TITLE]
;;Project Title/Notes
Exercise 4 - batch reactor: closed storage tank, TSS settling C = TSS*EXP(-0.5*DT/3600)

[OPTIONS]
FLOW_UNITS           CFS
INFILTRATION         HORTON
FLOW_ROUTING         DYNWAVE
LINK_OFFSETS         DEPTH
MIN_SLOPE            0
ALLOW_PONDING        NO
START_DATE           01/01/2026
START_TIME           00:00:00
REPORT_START_DATE    01/01/2026
REPORT_START_TIME    00:00:00
END_DATE             01/01/2026
END_TIME             12:00:00
DRY_DAYS             0
REPORT_STEP          00:10:00
WET_STEP             00:01:00
DRY_STEP             00:05:00
ROUTING_STEP         0:00:05
VARIABLE_STEP        0.75

[STORAGE]
;;Name  InvertElev  MaxDepth  InitDepth  Shape  Coeff  Expon  Const  SurDepth  Fevap
;10 ft x 10 ft tank holding 3 ft of water; the outlet pipe sits 4 ft up, so nothing flows out
TANK  100  6  3  FUNCTIONAL  0  0  100  0  0

[OUTFALLS]
;;Name  Elevation  Type  StageData  Gated
OUT1  95  FREE  NO

[CONDUITS]
;;Name  FromNode  ToNode  Length  Roughness  InOffset  OutOffset  InitFlow  MaxFlow
C1  TANK  OUT1  50  0.013  4  0  0  0

[XSECTIONS]
C1  CIRCULAR  1  0  0  0  1

[POLLUTANTS]
;;Name  Units  Crain  Cgw  Crdii  Kdecay(1/day)  SnowOnly  CoPollut  CoFrac  Cdwf  Cinit(mg/L)
TSS  MG/L  0  0  0  0  NO  *  0  0  100

[TREATMENT]
;;Node  Pollutant  Function
TANK  TSS  C = TSS * EXP(-0.5*DT/3600)

[REPORT]
SUBCATCHMENTS ALL
NODES ALL
LINKS ALL

[MAP]
DIMENSIONS -50 -100 250 100
Units Feet

[COORDINATES]
TANK  0  0
OUT1  200  0
